name: TRIPLOG
description: TripLog is a comprehensive mileage tracking and expense management solution designed to help businesses and individuals efficiently manage their travel expenses. With features like automatic mileage tracking, expense reporting, and integration with accounting software, TripLog simplifies the process of tracking and managing travel-related costs.

events.d: Retrieve all users and optionally select which user fields to include.
Retrieve the list of current tracked locations from TripLog.
List state-by-state mileage for selected dates, a user, or a state.
List TripLog vehicles using an email address and/or last-updated date range.
List all Trips corresponding to email.
Retrieve TripLog custom tags for use in workflows.
